entry.title: Publisher retires October 2026: what happens to your .pub files
entry.summary: Publisher leaves Microsoft 365 on 1 October 2026. The exact dates, what Microsoft recommends, and every option for opening and converting .pub files afterwards, including on a Mac.

entry.title: How to open .pub files on a Mac (2026)

entry.title: Publisher alternatives for churches and schools
